_readme: The runtime configuration document for the DEVELOPMENT build of the login host.
Copy it to the root of the directory you serve, next to index.html, as `config.json`.
Everything here is optional: with no document at all the host runs on the defaults below,
and a mnemonic sign-in needs no key, no account and no network.
A production build IGNORES this file and says so in the console when it finds one.
devMnemonic: test test test test test test test test test test test junk
